operators.rounding: floor and ceiling division swapped; Down/Up and floor/ceil helpers swapped
operators.arith: arithmetic operator swapped (+ and -, * to /), unary minus dropped
operators.logic: boolean connective swapped (&& and ||, and and or), boolean literal flipped
operators.drop-conjunct: one conjunct of a guard replaced by true
operators.guard: if-condition replaced by true or false (guard dropped or branch removed)
operators.field: state field update dropped, or a field read replaced by another field of the same value
operators.swap: arguments swapped (non-commutative operator operands, adjacent function arguments, min and max)
operators.constant: numeric constant changed (n+1, n-1, n*10, n/10)
